description: This Java class defines the UsernamePasswordAuthenticationScheme, which implements an authentication mechanism using usernames and passwords for OpenMRS, extending the DaoAuthenticationScheme and providing the authenticate method.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthenticationScheme
classes.description: A Java class that provides username-password based authentication scheme in OpenMRS, extending DaoAuthenticationScheme and overriding the authenticate method.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials by verifying the username and password, returning an Authenticated object upon success or throwing a ContextAuthenticationException on failure.
